title: 第14章 阎君第15章 狩猎求追读
content_zh:
“得小心一些。”
陆沉跟在人群中，举起大枪将一头小狼逼退，心中不由嘀咕起来。
那黑鳞狼的叫声很奇怪，像是在呼唤外出的狼王。
想到这里，他不敢再留在人群中央，而是悄无声息的拉着韩枫往山谷入口的左侧角落而去。
“锵——”
就在陆沉心中犯嘀咕的时候，这场大战已经有了关键结果。
那沈衡大发神威，仅仅交手不到十招，就一刀劈死了那头暗劲母狼。
剩下的三头明劲黑鳞狼更是不堪一击，一头被林武劈杀，两个在几个明劲师兄的围攻下更是各个带伤。
此时等林武腾出手，不用沈衡帮忙就迅速料理了。
“不要伤了幼狼。”
沈衡杀了母狼，顿时神色大悦，招呼起众人抓捕幼狼，
黑鳞狼幼崽能够驯化，所以价值极高，拿回去一头怕是就能卖出千两白银。
“六头幼崽，加上斩杀的这些黑鳞狼，这次我们沈氏武馆发财了。”
武馆学徒们露出喜色，当即堵住缺口抓捕幼崽。
陆沉没有急着参与，而是尽量向着角落靠拢，此地一共只有四头成年异兽，怎么看也不像是一个完整的黑鳞狼族群。
更像是狼王带着狼群外出狩猎的样子。
“呼——”
而就在这个时候，陆沉突然听到一阵呼啸声。
他转头看去，只见山谷外一道巨大的黑影扑面而来，向着人群猛扑了过去。
只一个照面，四五个学徒就横飞了十余丈，撞在石壁上眼看就是活不成了。

“孽障——”
沈衡神色骤然一变，猛地一跃十余丈，拔刀向着那道黑影力劈而来。
霎时间，一道黑色气劲与刀光碰撞，一阵剧烈的碰撞之后，双方均是爆退十丈有余。
沈衡稳稳地落在山石之上，将脚下巨石踩出一道道细微的裂痕。
再回头看去，只见那黑影是一头巨狼，其长度足有近两丈，冷冷的趴在那里，周身有黑色煞气笼罩。
“劲力外放，高等异兽——黑阎君。”
沈衡低语，瞳孔露出一丝震惊。
陆沉闻言，心中骤然一沉。
黑阎君，是传说中能让小儿止啼的高等异兽。
传说其擅使罡气，可吞虎豹豺狼，又行走无声，喜在夜间闯入村镇，遇到谁家不熄灯，便会破门叼走一家老小，故而得名‘黑阎君’。
论及危险程度，此兽比起‘游山鼓’还要恐怖，等闲化境高人遇上都会有殒命的危险。
“此地怎会诞生一头黑阎君？”
沈衡心中震惊，握刀的右手微微颤抖，目光中露出一抹担忧。
而就在这个时候，远处又传来阵阵狼嚎之声，只见九头黑鳞狼从远处而来，将目光森冷的将整个山谷围了起来。
“糟糕。”
沈衡心中微沉，眼角余光又看向一旁的林武和武馆弟子：“我若独自离去，这些弟子和学徒怕是没几人能活下来。”
“而且我杀其妻儿老小，速度也比不得这黑阎君，此獠怕是也不会让我轻易离去。”
“不如拼死一战，”
迅速评估之后，沈衡做出了决定。
content_en:
"Gotta be careful."
Lu Chen followed the crowd, raised his big gun and forced a small wolf back, and couldn't help but murmur in his heart.
The cry of the black-scaled wolf was very strange, as if it was calling the wolf king who was out.
Thinking of this, he did not dare to stay in the center of the crowd anymore, but quietly pulled Han Feng towards the left corner of the valley entrance.
"Qiang——"
Just when Lu Chen was murmuring in his heart, the key result of this battle had already been reached.
Shen Heng showed great power, and in less than ten moves, he killed the Anjin she-wolf with one strike.
The remaining three Mingjin black-scaled wolves were even more vulnerable. One was killed by Lin Wu, and two were injured under the siege of several Mingjin senior brothers.
At this time, Lin Wutang took action and quickly cooked without Shen Heng's help.
"Don't hurt the wolf cub."
After Shen Heng killed the mother wolf, he immediately looked happy and called on everyone to capture the cubs.
Black-scaled wolf cubs can be domesticated, so they are extremely valuable. One of them can be sold for a thousand taels of silver.
"With six cubs, plus the black-scaled wolves we killed, our Shen Family Martial Arts School will make a fortune this time."
The martial arts apprentices looked happy and immediately blocked the gap to capture the cubs.
Lu Chen did not rush to participate, but tried to move closer to the corner. There were only four adult beasts here, and they did not look like a complete group of black-scaled wolves.
It looks more like a wolf king leading a pack of wolves out for hunting.
"Huh——"
At this moment, Lu Chen suddenly heard a whistling sound.
He turned around and saw a huge black shadow rushing toward the crowd from outside the valley.
With just one look, the four or five apprentices flew more than ten feet away and crashed into the stone wall, where they looked dead.
"Evil obstacle——"
Shen Heng's expression suddenly changed, he jumped more than ten feet, drew his sword and struck at the black shadow.
In an instant, a black energy collided with the light of the sword. After a violent collision, both sides were pushed back by more than ten feet.
Shen Heng landed firmly on the rocks, and stepped on the boulders under his feet to create tiny cracks.
Looking back, I saw that the black shadow was a giant wolf, nearly two feet long, lying there coldly, with a black evil aura surrounding it.
"Expose your strength to the high-level alien beast—Hei Yanjun."
Shen Heng whispered, his pupils showing a hint of shock.
When Lu Chen heard this, his heart suddenly sank.
Black Yama Lord is a legendary high-level beast that can stop children from crying.
Legend has it that he is good at using Gang Qi and can swallow tigers, leopards and wolves. He also walks silently and likes to break into villages and towns at night. If he encounters a house that does not turn off the lights, he will break down the door and take away the whole family, hence the name "Hei Yanjun".
In terms of the degree of danger, this beast is more terrifying than the 'Wandering Mountain Drum', and even an expert in the transformation realm will be in danger of death if he encounters it.
"How could a Black Lord of Hell be born here?"
Shen Heng was shocked, his right hand holding the knife trembled slightly, and there was a hint of worry in his eyes.
At this time, the sound of howling wolves came from the distance again, and nine black-scaled wolves were seen coming from a distance, surrounding the entire valley with cold eyes.
"Oops."
Shen Heng's heart sank slightly, and he looked at Lin Wu and the martial arts disciples standing aside from the corner of his eyes: "If I leave alone, I'm afraid not many of these disciples and apprentices will survive."
"Besides, I couldn't kill his wife, children, and children as fast as Hei Yanjun. I'm afraid this beast won't let me leave easily."
"It's better to fight to the death,"
After a quick assessment, Shen Heng made a decision.
